structured.answer: Harel has tons (96 tracks in 7 products plus 5 index funds and 4 ETFs). I'd go S&P 500: in קופת גמל להשקעה or קרן השתלמות that track costs about 0.5–0.56% of savings and made ~13.7% a year over 3 years, and the הראל מחקה S&P 500 fund looks cheaper (0.1%) but shows no returns.

stuck.why: Endless rows of pension tracks with the same look; got bored and just thumbed past, would probably have closed the page on my phone here
Fees split into קבועים/משתנים/נאמן and no returns at all, so I couldn't compare them with the tracks above

stuck.where: מניות track in קרן השתלמות (21.45%) vs S&P (13.71%)
stuck.why: Higher number made me doubt whether S&P is the right pick

used: Heading הראל and 'כל המוצרים של הראל' with product buttons and counts
Row 'עוקב מדד S&P 500' in קופת גמל להשקעה: 0.56% מהחיסכון, 13.7% 3 שנים, 11.92% 5 שנים
Row 'עוקב מדד S&P 500' in קרן השתלמות: 0.5%, 13.71%
Group header lines 'דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%'
skimmed: קרן חדשה מקיפה and קרן חדשה כללית sections
skipped: Small notes PF-06 and PF-10 under the table
Line about the companies included and '123 מקור / 123 מחושב'
unsure_meaning: Whether 13.7% is per year or total over 3 years
Teal vs yellow dot colours in the rings (guessed stocks vs foreign currency)
Number next to the arrow icon (e.g. 13414) – guessed it's a code
not_found: Returns for the קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל
A clear recommendation of what to do first
Fee shown in shekels for an amount like 30,000 ₪
Which track my own savings are in

findings.what: Every row repeats the same labels (מניות/מט"ח, מהחיסכון/מההפקדות, 3 שנים/5 שנים), so I re-read the same words on 96 rows to find what differs
Many tracks show only 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so half the rows can't be compared
Index funds and ETFs show no returns at all and split fees into three unfamiliar parts
findings.where: קרנות מחקות and קרנות סל tables

findings.what: Very long page on a phone; the funds I care about are at the very bottom after pages of pension tracks
Fees only as small percents, nothing in shekels, so they feel like nothing
Donut colours explained only by small dots next to words; had to match ring colours with the numbers beside them
Jargon in coloured tags (מנוטרלת מט"ח, מס נגדי על שינויי המטבע, צוברת) not explained
findings.where: Fund name tags in קרנות מחקות/סל
